title: Luxe Interface — Analyse & Packaging Redesign
summary: YTIntel's highest-value screens now use a new premium visual system: stronger hierarchy, richer depth, coral-led interaction design, source-evidence rails, a featured best-match package, cleaner package folders and a more polished Visuals + Audio experience without changing the underlying intelligence logic.
discord_changes: Analyse and Packaging Lab now use a substantially upgraded premium visual system with stronger hierarchy, lighting, depth and action states.
Packaging results now visually prioritise the strongest package, make thumbnail/hook evidence easier to scan and give the Package Library a cleaner expandable-folder treatment.
Visuals + Audio, navigation, inputs, loading states, modals and responsive mobile layouts now share the same polished YTIntel design language.
changes: Added a new v0.28.4 luxe visual layer with a premium black/charcoal base, coral and rose interaction accents, subtle violet/cyan depth and restrained green success states.
Rebuilt the Analyse hero hierarchy with stronger typography, a premium URL input/CTA treatment and a five-part evidence rail for Transcript, Replay, Visuals, Outlier and Intelligence.
Rebuilt the Packaging Lab hero around deep source-specific packaging and added visible source chips for transcript, exact examples, replay moments, visual evidence and max reasoning.
Turned the first generated package into a featured best-match card while keeping the remaining package options clean and comparable.
Improved package cards with richer surface depth, clearer score treatment, stronger thumbnail-direction and opening-hook panels, full-width primary actions and more polished evidence expanders.
Restyled the Package Library as a premium expandable archive with clearer active/open states and better visual separation between saved sessions.
Applied the same premium system to Visuals + Audio, report cards, cloud/account modals, navigation states, loading/error feedback and responsive layouts.
Added subtle micro-interactions, hover elevation, CTA light sweeps and ambient brand lighting while respecting reduced-motion preferences.
Bumped the PWA shell to v0.28.4 so installed copies receive both the deep Packaging Lab and the new visual system.
why_it_matters: YTIntel should look as valuable as the work it saves. The redesign makes the core research and packaging workflows feel faster to understand, more premium to use and more desirable at first glance without sacrificing evidence density or turning the product into decorative noise.
